short: Indonesia has no AI law. Two draft presidential regulations, on AI ethics and on a 2026 to 2029 national AI roadmap, finished inter-ministerial review on 5 May 2026; the binding layer is the Personal Data Protection Law No. 27 of 2022.
title: Indonesia AI Laws
subtitle: Two draft presidential regulations on AI, and the PDP Law that binds
body_html:
Status at a glance

AI rules pending. Indonesia has no AI law. The Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi) drafted two presidential regulations: one on AI ethics (Rancangan Peraturan Presiden tentang Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial) and one on a national AI roadmap for 2026 to 2029. Inter-ministerial discussion ended on 5 May 2026, and the drafts await the President; no signing was found. A presidential regulation is made by the executive, not passed by the legislature. The binding layer is the Personal Data Protection Law, No. 27 of 2022. Verified on 25 October 2026 against Komdigi's legal documentation network.

Key instruments

InstrumentNumberStageIn force
Draft Presidential Regulation on AI EthicsDraftInter-ministerial review closed 5 May 2026No
Draft Presidential Regulation on the National AI Roadmap 2026 to 2029DraftInter-ministerial review closed 5 May 2026No
Law on Personal Data Protection (Undang-Undang tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi)Law No. 27 of 2022Enacted and promulgated 17 October 2022On promulgation (Art. 76); two years to comply (Art. 74)

Who regulates and enforces

  • Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi): drafted both AI regulations.
  • The PDP agency: to be established by the President (Art. 58(3)), its details set by presidential regulation (Art. 58(5)); whether it has been established was not confirmed.

Scope and reach

No AI instrument is in force. The PDP Law applies to every person, public body and international organisation (Art. 2(1)), including certain acts outside Indonesia, and excludes personal and household processing (Art. 2(2)).

Core obligations

  • The PDP Law's duties for controllers and processors, which had to be met within two years of promulgation (Art. 74).

Penalties

BreachMaximumProvisionEnforcer
Administrative breaches of the PDP LawA fine of up to 2% of annual revenue or receipts, against the variable of the breachPDP Law Art. 57(3)PDP agency
Unlawfully obtaining or collecting personal dataUp to 5 years' imprisonment and a finePDP Law Art. 67(1)Courts
Offences committed by a corporationFines of up to ten times the maximumPDP Law Art. 70(3)Courts

What is coming next

  • The President's signature of the two draft regulations, targeted for 2026.

Related

  • Global AI Laws: every jurisdiction compared, with the world map
  • AI Policy Ledger, the law tracker
  • AI lawsuit tracker and AI news

Sources

  • Government completes discussion of the draft presidential regulations, 6 May 2026, Komdigi JDIH
  • Inter-ministerial meeting on the draft AI ethics regulation, 18 February 2026, Komdigi JDIH
  • Law No. 27 of 2022, Komdigi JDIH

Last verified

25 October 2026, against the sources above. Not confirmed on an official source and therefore left out: the rupiah amounts of the criminal fines, and whether the PDP agency has been established.
